prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing Desktop Pet", "Pet Care Essentials", "Learn how to interact with your desktop companion before it lands on your desktop.", "Right-click for controls, drag to move, click to interact."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate"]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet"]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Active!", "Desktop Pet Active"]
4: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Signing in with your account automatically restores your previously adopted desktop pets and settings."]
5: ["Your pet is initializing and will appear directly on your taskbar once complete.", "Make sure desktop display overlay permissions are enabled if prompted by your operating system."]
6: ["For best custom pet results, upload a well-lit, clear photo with a distinct background.", "Photo Tip: High Contrast & Bright Light"]
7: ["Choose & Customize Your Friend", "Choose Companion Aura", "Select a color aura or background style for your new desktop pet."]
8: ["Right-click your pet or system tray icon anytime to open pet controls, hide, or summon your companion."]
9: ["Sign in to activate automatic cloud backup for all adopted desktop pets and customized settings.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
